prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Xu Shu from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the wandering swordswoman turned strategist who left for her mother's letter. Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

Style (fixed): Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

Inspiration only: a former knight-errant in a scholar's robe over a swordswoman's belt, filial devotion, quiet melancholy, a vow never to devise a plan for the enemy, a folded letter tucked at her belt.

World (fixed): a righteous highland kingdom of Western medieval high fantasy: grey-stone castles and fortified abbeys on green mountain ridges, alpine meadows, waterfalls and oak forests, heraldic banners of green and gold bearing a dragon device, oaths sworn under an ancient oak, gentle green nature-magic. Her costume, weapon and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) a long floor-length robe with a high collar, wide sleeves and a shoulder mantle — a tall, mysterious mage's silhouette; 2) a light breastplate and bracers with robe panels split from the waist — half armor, half robe; 3) thin leaf-patterned armor plates and flowing light fabric panels with a slender circlet — a slender, graceful silhouette; 4) a long coat below the knees with epaulettes, a belt, gloves and tall boots — a crisp, commanding officer's silhouette; 5) a floor-length priestly vestment with gold-trimmed stoles and a tall head ornament — a long, devout silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her legend, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like feathers, scales or petals, a hem or sleeve cut into a motif from her story. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Weapon (fixed — ours): a slim scholar's sword, reimagined as a Western high-fantasy version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: polished steel and silvered mithril throughout, the shaft or hilt also forged metal with engraved runes (never plain wood), a faint magical glow running along the edge and the runes, a gem-set guard or socket, a leather-wrapped grip and heraldic or elven ornament, with any animal motif re-sculpted in Western heraldic style and no Chinese fittings, silk tassels or hanzi.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): dark brown hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Skin tone (fixed — ours): fair skin. Keep exactly this skin tone.

Costume colours (ours): jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade, with small accents of deep navy blue and black lacquer (Cao Wei).

Rank (fixed): she is a master strategist — her costume must read scholarly prestige at first glance: elegant, layered and finely ornamented, with flagship-card detail, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Chosen design: silhouette 4, a commanding long coat below the knees with epaulettes, belt, gloves and tall boots. The coat panels overlap as sealed-letter folds, gold-edged angular lapels opening into a deep neckline; open shoulder construction and high side openings expose skin while preserving the commanding coat silhouette. Dark brown hair in a short wavy bob with a side part, compact oval face, natural pale hazel eyes, a restrained thoughtful smile. A richly layered jade-green officer-strategist coat, white-jade inner panels, gold filigree, brown belt and boots, tiny navy and black-lacquer accents. She stands at the fortified abbey courtyard overlooking highland waterfalls. One hand holds the single rune-lit mithril scholar sword vertically beside her, the other rests on an envelope-shaped fold at her belt. Full figure, both hands visible, human natural proportions.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers. No readable text, logo or watermark.
acceptance: user_approval_2026-11-13 — selected world candidates 1,3,3; upload and main publication authorized
